observations: Cobros y cartera showed non-zero aging amounts while Pendiente and Vencido filters returned 0 cobros / Sin cobros.
Reported-payment rows exposed Abrir recibo but no Aplicar pago action.
Cliente 360 > Recibos y pagos rendered current expected receipts without a row-level Aplicar pago action.
Expected receipt detail rendered Editar este recibo / Editar plan de recibos but no Aplicar pago action.
A pending receipt with portfolio balance could be opened but still had no payment action.
Reported-payment detail remained reachable as Pago reportado / pendiente de conciliar without an actionable canonical payment command.

rootCause.globalCobros: modules/cobros.js rows() consumed materialized cobros while aging consumed portfolio; portfolio-only expected receipts were omitted from the actionable table even though the B3-002 portfolio adapter already exposed them.
rootCause.cliente360: backend-lab-receipts-portfolio-native-bridge-v20260801.js is the effective runtime owner for Cliente 360 Recibos y pagos and receipt detail; it replaced cliente360.js rows and did not render payment actions.
rootCause.composition: The previously added canonical command existed, but the effective rendered owners did not converge on it.

behavior: Cobros y cartera unions materialized cobros with current portfolio-only receipts and keeps reported evidence deduplicated.
Every actionable current receipt exposes Aplicar pago in the list and in receipt detail; paid-unreconciled rows expose Conciliar.
Cliente 360 runtime projection delegates row/detail actions to Orbit.modules.cobros, which delegates to the canonical reconciliation domain.
A receipt ID can open the same canonical payment flow even before a cobro document exists.
